description: HushPinterest v0.0.9: 29 patches for Pinterest 14.40.0, which needs Android 10 or newer. New in this release: HushPinterest has its own row in Pinterest's Settings and can show its settings in English, AMOLED black adds Black comments and Black pin menu, and Black bottom bar and Hide save toasts cover what they used to miss. Validation: 943 runtime tests passed. All 219 patch tests passed. All 29 patches applied without forcing to Pinterest 14.40.0. Needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Pinterest APK. Uninstall the stock app first, then sign in with your email and a Pinterest password.
